§aHBM doesn't use vanilla armor. Time to learn the real system.§f

Every piece of NTM armor has three stats: Damage Threshold (DT), Damage Resistance (DR), and Radiation Resistance (RR). DT is a flat number that blocks damage entirely if the hit is below it. DR is a percentage reduction after DT applies. RR stacks across all four pieces, and the formula 10^(-totalRR) means each point is exponentially more valuable.

The combat line goes Steel, Titanium, Advanced Alloy, Cobalt, Starmetal, Schrabidium, CMB Steel, and Dineutronium.

The hazmat line goes Basic, Advanced, High-Performance, Liquidator, and PaA Battle Hazmat.

§9Note:§f Different damage types (Explosion, Fire, Physical, Energy) each have separate DT and DR values. AP ammo cuts DR, while DTN rounds reduce DT.
